resources.string: Charge Controller Accessibility Service. Used to attempt sending keyboard events (W/A/S/D) to other apps such as GameHub. This service must be enabled manually in Android Settings → Accessibility. It does not guarantee key injection into third-party apps due to Android security restrictions.
Overlay permission is required to show the gamepad on top of other apps.
Accessibility Service must be enabled manually in Settings to attempt key injection. This is not automatic and is restricted by Android.

Permissions required:

• SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW: Show gamepad overlay on top of other apps.
• FOREGROUND_SERVICE: Keep overlay running while charging.
• Accessibility Service: Attempt to inject W/A/S/D key events (not guaranteed by Android, especially for GameHub).

No permission is used without your explicit consent.
